The lowest common ancestor of Cyanocobalamin and Casp9 is Hydroxocobalamin, suggesting a shared functional role in the binding process. The presence of a high score in the relationship between Cyanocobalamin and Casp9 implies a significant functional link, though the exact mechanism of interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
